findings.text: The survey incorrectly calls the private `simple_results_append` a specialization of `Query.simple_results_append`, although it supports different filters and appended-column reads that the latter excludes. Fix: describe the distinct translation capability so it is retained during deduplication.

The existing laws do not require a TEXT source column; they accept arbitrary source affinities and values, with TEXT required for the appended column. Fix: correct this description and the corresponding survey description in the status file.
